edit.statement: 'Is the successor of' is not a subproperty of 'was released after': the successor of a product need not have been released after it.
edit.subject: successor_of
edit.original: 'Is the successor of' is a subproperty of 'was released after': the successor of a product was released after it.
edit.scope: Whether being the successor of a product is enough to conclude that one was released after it.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'is the successor of' a subproperty of 'was released after', so that the successor of a product was released after it?

cross_lingual.prompt: Windows 11 是 Windows 10 的后继版本。能否由此推出 Windows 11 是在 Windows 10 之后发布的？
Windows 11 es el sucesor de Windows 10. ¿Se deduce que Windows 11 se lanzó después de Windows 10?

derived.prompt: Windows 11 is the successor of Windows 10. Does it follow that Windows 11 was released after Windows 10?
bridge: Windows 11 is the successor of Windows 10.

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Derived premises are true facts about real software, stated in the prompt. The premises and conclusions are true in the world, so before the edit the conclusion follows from the premise by the subproperty; after it, the conclusion no longer follows from the premise alone. The panel's reflexivity item (TR5) is no longer used, so this record has no panel source.
